items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.8
items.summary: Anthropic describes Claude Opus 4.8 as a modest upgrade over Opus 4.7, with more reliable agentic work and better honesty about flaws in its own code. Standard pricing is unchanged at $5/$25 per million tokens, and fast mode was cut to $10/$50.
